'''Hutts and the Underworld''' is a featurette included in the Blu-ray and DVD release of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]]. It covers the development of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|season three]] episodes "[[Evil Plans]]" and "[[Hunt for Ziro]]."

The featurette is divided into six thematics:
*[[Coruscant]]
*[[Droid Spa|The Droid Spa]]
*[[Hutt Clan|The Hutts]]
*[[Nal Hutta]]
*[[Sy Snootles]]
*[[Quinlan Vos]]
